# Served at https://docs.mapflow.ai/robots.txt
#
# Copied verbatim into the build via `html_extra_path`, which conf.py enables
# only for the root-language build — a robots.txt under /ru/ or /es/ would be
# ignored by crawlers anyway.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# AI answer engines — allowed deliberately. The model reference pages are the
# most citable content Mapflow publishes.
User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /

# One sitemap per language build. Each is generated by sphinx-sitemap and
# contains only that language's URLs.
Sitemap: https://docs.mapflow.ai/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://docs.mapflow.ai/ru/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://docs.mapflow.ai/es/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://docs.mapflow.ai/zh/sitemap.xml
